entry.title: PotentialNoise 2.6.0
entry.summary: **PotentialNoise 2.6.0** - New **Hi-Fi** look (the fifth on the LOOK selector, from PotentialBox): walnut cheeks, a brushed charcoal faceplate, raised panels, domed knobs lit in the plugin's colour, moulded cream keys and green glass displays. - The LOOK selector now has five looks: Print Plate, Night Rack, Colour Block, Vintage and Hi-Fi.

entry.title: PotentialNoise 2.5.1
entry.summary: **PotentialNoise 2.5.1** - **Loads about 100 times faster.** It used to measure its own noise every time it loaded (6 seconds of noise for each of its 12 signals), which took about 140 ms on an MPC One. The levels are now built in, the same calibrated numbers, so it loads in well under a millisecond like the rest of the suite. Levels and sound are unchanged.

entry.title: PotentialNoise 2.5.0
entry.summary: **PotentialNoise 2.5.0** - **A fourth look: Vintage.** A late-80s drum machine: warm grey panel, cream keys with a hard shadow, an amber display, and PotentialNoise's own colour for what's selected. It is Potential1200's look, now in the whole PotentialSuite. Pick it with the LOOK keys on the SETTINGS (or SETUP) page; Print Plate stays the default.

entry.title: PotentialNoise 2.4.0
entry.summary: **PotentialNoise 2.4.0** - **MANUAL page.** The plugin's manual is now on the MPC's screen: tap **MANUAL**, then the page buttons along the top (what it does, the controls, how it works with the other PotentialSuite plugins, and good-to-know notes). The full PotentialSuite manual is on the [PotentialSuite page](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/potential-plugins). - One parameter was added at the end of the list (Manual Page); saved projects open as before. Sound and controls are unchanged.

entry.title: PotentialNoise 2.0.2
entry.summary: - Fixed: pressing **STOP** or **Overdub** while the MPC was playing could switch the noise on for a moment. The MPC's host briefly changes a plugin's first parameter when it re-prepares audio, and that was ON/OFF. That first slot now does nothing; ON/OFF is a new parameter at the end (same switch, same Q-Link). Saved projects open as before.
